note: Hand-written knowledge the manifest does not carry yet (canonical examples for a few components live in snippets/). Allowed parents, required children and hints for guessed attributes are in the manifest itself (voidParents, voidRequires, voidHints; source packages/ui/cem/supplement.js). Styled elements are CSS-only void-* tags that @voidable/theme styles and nothing registers; the manifest does not hold them, so each declares its own allowed parents here.

styled.description: Frame of an application: a void-nav-bar or void-sidebar, then <main>. The first thing in <body>.

attributes.name: nav
attributes.description: top: bar above the page. side: void-sidebar beside it (a bar across the top below 48rem). overlay: bar laid over the top of the page, for a page that opens on a void-media

styled.description: Product name (and mark) in a nav bar or sidebar; put an <a> inside to link it home.
Links of a void-nav-bar or void-sidebar: <a> children, the current one marked aria-current="page". A row that scrolls sideways when it runs out of room; a column in a sidebar.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: vertical stacks the links (automatic inside void-sidebar)

styled.description: Empty flexible gap: pushes what follows it to the far end of a void-nav-bar or void-toolbar.
Content column of a page, inside <main>: centred, with a gutter, its blocks a group apart and its void-section children a section apart. Never write page padding or max-width by hand.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: narrow for forms and reading; wide and full for dense tables and dashboards

styled.description:

attributes.name: flush
attributes.description: no hairline and no padding under the head

styled.description: Row of buttons that wraps: page actions, form buttons, row actions in a table cell.

hints.align: use justify (align is a legacy HTML attribute that sets text-align)

attributes.name: justify
attributes.description: where the buttons sit in the row (end for the buttons of a form)

styled.description: Titled part of a page: a void-section-head (or a bare <h2>), then content. No box and no shadow.

attributes.name: divided
attributes.description: hairline under the head, for content with no line of its own (a form, a paragraph, a chart)

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: space between the blocks in the section; stack for the fields of a form

Two columns that collapse to one below 48rem.

hints.align: use valign (align is a legacy HTML attribute that sets text-align)

attributes.name: ratio

attributes.name: valign

styled.description: Vertical stack with a named gap from the layout rhythm.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: tight 8px, inside 16px, stack 24px, group 40px, section 72px at the default knobs

attributes.name: sticky
attributes.description: as a child of void-split: stays in view while the other column scrolls

styled.description: Row of void-figure children divided by hairlines. Two columns below 48rem.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: figures per row

styled.description: One number that matters. Children in order: a data-void-type="label" span, a data-void-type="value" span holding the number and a data-void-type="unit" span, an optional void-progress, a data-void-type="caption" span (which may hold a void-delta).
A change with its direction: an arrow and a colour around the text ("4.2%").

attributes.name: trend
attributes.description: direction of the change

attributes.name: invert
attributes.description: less is better: down is green and up is red

styled.description: A state as a coloured dot and a word. The word is the content and is required, so colour is never the only signal.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: default is grey (idle, off, unknown)

attributes.name: pulse
attributes.description: animated ring: something happening now

styled.description: Labels and their values. Wraps a native <dl> whose pairs are each a <div> holding a <dt> and a <dd>.

attributes.name: layout
attributes.description: rows: label left, value right, a hairline between pairs. grid: label over value, pairs side by side

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: columns of pairs (rows: 1 or 2; grid: 1 to 4, default 2)

styled.description: List of void-row children with a hairline between them: settings, events, anything that is one thing per line and not tabular.
One row of void-rows: a void-row-text on the left, a value or one control on the right.
Two lines of text: a main line and a data-void-type="caption" line. In a void-row or a table cell.
Row of controls above a table or list: search field, filters, void-spacer, then ghost icon buttons. Wraps.

styled.description:
Content region of a void-media: an

(set large), a

, void-actions, a void-glass panel. Draws the scrim behind itself.

Glass panel: a translucent, blurred surface for a form or status panel over an image: dark in both colour schemes inside void-media, in the page colour scheme elsewhere. Solid where backdrop-filter is unavailable or reduced transparency is requested. data-void-surface="glass" gives any component the same surface.
